lines.en: I had zero sex after returning from the beach last night. But I suppose that’s just what I get for insulting an entire spa worth of girls by sneaking away while they were fighting over my penis.

I imagine today will be different, though. Because, with an entire class worth of girls on the way here right now, there is bound to be at least one or two of them horny enough to still sleep with me despite being slighted.

Either that or this is where my story ends. And everything from this point on becomes the typical all-ages romantic comedy it was meant to be before I showed up and set fire to it with my rampant libido.
Ready to ruin some lives and subsequently complain about it, I slide the door of my room (which I slept in alone, thank you very much) open and step out into the sun.
Thankfully, I encounter three of my co-stars immediately afterward and don’t have to stand around trying not to be judged by you anymore.
Hooray for adult companionship that I will definitely maintain throughout the weekend and not accidentally destroy in one way or another.
: Morning, Senpai! Whatcha up to?
: Oh, just foreshadowing. You guys are here early.
: I want to fucking die.
: I got to drive the school bus! And to Wakana’s dismay, we only almost died once.
: You let her behind the wheel of a vehicle students were inside of? I thought you were supposed to be keeping everyone safe in my absence?

: Hey, man. If I can drive the Dir En Grey tour bus from Kyushu to Kanto after their regular driver mysteriously drowned in a soapland, I think I can handle getting from the school to here in mostly one piece.
: Which is great since all of us dying a fiery crash would probably spawn some sort of melodramatic anime I wouldn’t be able to collect royalties for on account of being a ghost.
: Please remember who you’re talking to while dropping hypotheticals like that. The last thing I need this weekend is Arakawa stealing my thunder in the department of sorrow.
: Department of Sorrow would be a cool band name. Can I drive the tour bus for them too?

: Just hang on until tonight, Wakana. We will cure your misery with all the alcohol you can possibly stomach. Which is pretty much all of it. So there’s a chance we might accidentally usher in a new prohibition tonight.
: Do you guys have some sort of occasion planned?
: Yeah, and you’re coming. It’s Friday, which means it’s time for all of us to get hammered since we can’t exactly go to the bar while we’re chaperoning a field trip.
: You can’t exactly chaperone a field trip while hammered either, can you?
: No, but we can probably leave them alone for a couple hours without anybody getting into trouble. Especially if you’re with us, which you will be.
: I did bring a leash if you try and refuse. And I think all of us would very much enjoy getting to use it on you as an FYI.
: Why are you even here, Arakawa?
: Same reason anyone comes here. To catch some waves and show off my beach body.
: No, I meant why are you here this early? Miyamura wouldn’t divulge to me why you decided to get a leg up on all of us and stay over on Thursday as well.
: Are you upset I didn’t invite you along?
: Kind of, yes. I’ll take any excuse to get out of my apartment right now. Even if that excuse involves spending additional time beside the walking tragedy that is you.
: I’d have liked an invite too, Senpai. You could have showed off your beach body to me privately if you were that excited about it.
: I don’t like euphemisms, so I’m just going to directly say that I would have liked to have sex with you last night as well.
: This complete lack of tact is why all of us are teachers and you aren’t.
: Is “tact” another word for “education?”
: Arakawa-
: I just wanted to get out of the house as well, Wakana. Please remember that I experience misery just as much as you. It’s important to my character.
: I see. Then, I suppose we can talk more about this later as it is far too early for me to be awake and I am going to nap until the sun sets.
: We’re gonna head inside and get situated. Were you heading over to breakfast? A few of the girls were asking if you’d be there and I didn’t even realize you were already here.
: I suppose that would be the right thing to do. But I am only doing this because you asked and not because I want to see them in swimwear.
: You know, with out-front honesty like that, I don’t really understand how I ever suspected you of anything.
: Senpai-
: Farewell, fellow adults.
: Hah...
: Think we’ll get to see him take his shirt off if we follow him for a little while?
I escape the first of many obstacles as I depart from the inn and follow the coastline, dialing the number of someone who, several days ago, informed me that she’d be receiving her “penance” today.
: Hello?
That someone is Noriko if you are both blind and deaf but can communicate with me telepathically.
: Morning. Everything still going according to plan?
: I’m not sure I’d call it a “plan” when I’m just hanging out in my room. But if you’re curious about whether or not Nee-chan knows where you are yet, I don’t think so.
: You’re still tagging along for press stuff then?
: Not like I had much of a choice when she came at me with, “It’s the least you can do to help after fucking my boyfriend.” Her big-sister card is so much stronger now and I hate it.
: Have you seen Kirin’s new swimsuit yet? She wouldn’t shut up about wanting you to see it last night.
: I haven’t seen anyone but the other teachers yet. I’m heading to breakfast now.
: Well, tell her she’s cute when you do see her, okay? And tell me you miss me since I’ve earned at least that much for distracting Nee-chan until you get back.
: I miss you.
: Ugh, great. Now I’m turned on. Thanks.
: It’s so unfair that you get to return to ground zero of my defloration while I get to watch my sister bow and apologize all weekend.
: I want my back to hurt too, you know. Just for different reasons that all involve your penis and-
: Noriko? Are you-
: Go away! I’m masturbating!
: Ew! Are you dressed at least?
: Mostly!
: Well, hurry the fuck up! Mom wants you downstairs for breakfast!

: I have to go, Onii-chan. I’d say try not to miss me too much, but what I really want is for you to think about me every time you walk past the room where we had five hours worth of hot pseudo-incestuous sex together.
: I will. I promise. Before you go, though, were you also able to-
: Nope. Ami laughed in my face and told me she wasn’t about to miss out on an opportunity to show off her lack of tits in front of you all weekend.
: That’s not exactly how she worded it and I may have embellished a little, but I know that’s what she meant. So she’s probably on her way to the beach now if she’s not already there.
: Tch. Got it. Thank you for trying.
: How do you feel about flat chests by the way? Like, what’s your ideal size? Should I be thinking about getting a reduction?
I hang up the phone before I’m forced to make an impossible decision and-
Actually, hold that thought.
: Good morning, Touka. I-
: Die a thousand deaths. And then a thousand more.
: Oh. Okay.
: Two thousand?
It appears that Touka is still mad at me for sleeping with Yasu. If she...even knows I slept with Yasu and isn’t just wallowing in forced uncertainty while succumbing to my infectious pessimism.
I’m not sure if I should apologize, though. But I’m not really sure how to approach her at all right now, so here’s hoping someone more approachable crosses my path next.
: Sensei! There ya are! Here to catch some waves and show off that beach bod?
: Oh, hey. I normally get the opposite of whatever I’m thinking about. Maybe this is is some sort of good omen and this weekend will be awesome?
: How come you never come down here in swim trunks anymore? Miku and I haven’t gotten to feel up your abs since our first trip here.
: Can I feel yours? That swimsuit is so cute that I suddenly feel compelled to tear it into shreds and drown you in the ocean.
: Oh, th...this old thing?...Y...You really think so? Hahah...hah...
: The heck was that drownin’ part for?
: Cuteness aggression. Like how I want to push you down and strangle you right now.
: That one sounds kinda hot, though. We had a whole section for stuff like that at the porn shop before Maki decided to fire me over my secret relationship with some guy I met online.
: You...mean me right?
: Oh, right. Kirin already knows you’re porkin’ me and I ain’t gotta pretend around her. Yeah, I mean you.
: I’ve technically only “porked you” once. But I don’t like that term, so I’m going to stop using it now.
: Hahah...heh...cute...he called me cute...
: Oi! Back to reality, Kirin. This kawaii act you’ve got goin’ on is makin’ me feel all weird inside.
: Oh! Yeah, I...sorry. Just...nobody’s ever told me they want to drown me before.
: That’s the part you liked?...
: Kind of, yeah. It’s like how I can’t look at Sensei without wanting to tie him to my sister’s bed and edge him for nine consecutive hours.
: Again, I think you guys are weavin’ this whole drowning thing into just general physical kinkiness and I ain’t really followin’.
: Is your sister here this time, Kirin?
: No. Why? Am I not enough for you or something?
: Noriko taught Kirin the eye thing and now she won’t stop doin’ it any time she wants something.
: Love me.
: I do love you.
: N...Not in public, you big jerk!
: Yeah, so that’s what I’ve been dealin’ with lately.
: Morning, you two! Love the new swimsuit, Molly. It really fits you.
: Aye, doesn’t it?! Not bad for my first time creating my own swimwear, right?
: The Emerald Guardian has voiced her excitement on numerous occasions now over wearing this for approximately one hour before turning into a boiled crustaceous sea creature.
: Oh, right. You get really bad sunburn, don’t you?
: I do. It is but one of the many reasons I refuse to go outside unless I am forced to. But there is a powerful, secret tincture one may use to combat the sun that not many know of!
: Molly, everyone uses sunscreen.

: But it feels so weird! And half of its purpose goes out the window if you have no one to apply it for you. Such a thing is a quintessential pillar to nearly every single beach episode, you know. Yet here I am, untouched!
: I will apply the tincture for you, Emerald Guardian. It is the easiest way for you to obtain your cliche OVA moment.

: No thank you, Kendo Princess. I’d prefer the Supreme Overlord be the one to do it. But I feel as if there is a separate sticky white fluid he’d prefer to cover me with in the event that I actually ask.
: Yeah. I don’t think semen provides much protection from the sun, unfortunately.
: This is true. But at least it tastes good.
: Um...what?
: I said, “at least it tastes good.” And by “it,” I was referring to semen. Not sunscreen, as previously mentioned.
: Uhh...surprise? The Kendo Princess has joined the, uhh...extracurricular activities club with the rest of us.
: I’m a bonafide whore now. Just like all of you. I can finally fit in.
: Do you actually like the taste?
: Wait, do you not?
: Are...Wait, are we all not just pretending to like it? I didn’t think anyone actually did. This is a joke, right?
: I like it. It tastes like love.
: I don’t care either way. You can put me in the neutral party.
: I could drink it by the gallon.
: Ew!
: Even I think that’s too much, Tsuneyo.
: One glass of cum, please. Shaken, not stirred.
: I’m trying to get her to tone it down, I swear. She hasn’t yet discerned what is socially acceptable yet.
: Yo! If it ain’t my favorite homie.
: Careful talking to me in public, Rin. The only brain cells left in your mom’s head are the ones she uses to protect you from my penis and she’s here right now.
: Is she? Because I don’t see her. Which means it’s now safe to penis me as much as you like.

: Please! Gaze upon these breasts and ask yourself how they would feel within your hands! Think deeply of how they have unknowingly longed for your touch and ask, why? How have I avoided them for so long?
: I mean, technically, I didn’t completely avoid them thanks to Otoha. But I imagine that’s still a sore spot, so...
: True! That was a very gross and bad thing you did, Sensei.
: Hey, I did see them that one time when I opened your door while you were getting dressed.
: And yet you did not seize them! How dare you!
: Regardless, we both know I like you now. So I was wondering if you wanted to add yourself to the list of tragic beach romances I’ve had in my life. As fleeting as the ocean itself.
: The ocean is a lot of things but I don’t think fleeting is one of them, Rin. If anything, it’ll likely consume us all. I just hope I get to drown Kirin in it before that happens.
: Oh, was your first instinct after seeing her new swimsuit also to drown her? Because even I got that. And I’m very rarely ever attracted to her, to be honest.
: I knew if anyone would understand my feelings, it would be you.
: Cause we’re besties, obviously. And, just to clarify, this is not me friend-zoning you like I have in the past.
: I know now that we’re the kind of besties who are best suited to ease the growing tension between us with the assistance of our bodies.
: That was so incredibly dumb. But very fitting if you are trying to flirt right now. It’s nice being on this end of your awkward advances for once.
: And it’s nice feeling comfortable enough to awkwardly advance on you! Which is why I’d like to invite you into my pants tomorrow.
: I can’t tell if you actually meant to say pants there not.
: Did I say pants? I didn’t mean to say pants. I didn’t even bring pants.
: So are you just inviting me out on some sort of date then? Do I get the same confession treatment everybody else got?
: It doesn’t need to be a date, per se. I just want to hang out with you tomorrow since we’ve never really gotten that chance here before apart from scattered mental breakdowns.
: Why tomorrow? Why not tonight?
: Because this is the day where you go around and talk to everybody and they all fight over your attention since they want you tonight.
: But if I invite you to do stuff tomorrow, you’ll be more inclined to say yes since nobody else has brought anything up about tomorrow yet. It’s a calculated move. I’m sneaky now.
: Well done, Rin. So well done that I’ll agree right here and now.
: Are you absolutely sure? Because if you agree and then something happens and you don’t show up tomorrow, I’m just never coming to the beach again.
: I am absolutely sure. And I also promise to not tell your mom about it while I am having sex with her tonight.
: Thank you, Sensei. I appreciate that. But please be careful with her. She is very old and likely breakable. And she gives me an allowance now that she is employed that I would like to keep.
: Oh man. I wanted you to get embarrassed and blush and beg me not to sleep with her. Now, I’m going to feel bad when I ultimately do.
: Another calculated move. I’m just always going to be one step ahead of you now. I know you too well, Sensei.
: I assume the way you’re standing is also calculated, then?
: Oh, have you noticed the fact that I’ve been slightly pushing out my chest this whole time? And hiding my arms behind my back to emphasize it and appear both comfortable and defenseless?
: You’re good.

: Just because I’m late to join the party doesn’t mean I’m at a disadvantage, Sensei. I’ve got the power of friendship on my side. And everyone knows the best relationships form with a foundation like that.
: Ah, maybe you should just date Molly then.
: Mmph...Real nice, buddy.
: See you tomorrow?
: Is it customary for the boy or the girl to bring condoms when sex is a possibility? I’ve never been heterosexual before.
: Condoms are a psy-op created by the pharmaceutical industry to perpetuate Japan’s birthrate crisis. I’m not bringing any and neither will you.
: Okaaaaaay. But if you knock me up, you’re going to have to cover all of my shifts at the cafe and find a babysitter for our child that isn’t my mom.
: Again, I will keep that in mind when I am having sex with her tonight.
: Please don’t think of me while having sex with my mom because it implies you’ll be thinking about her while having sex with me.
